name: Checkbox
purpose: Provide an independent checked, unchecked, or mixed selection with keyboard, pointer, touch, and form behavior.
useWhen: A user independently turns an option on or off, or an aggregate parent represents mixed child selection.

avoidWhen.condition: Exactly one option must be selected from a set.

composition: Compose Checkbox.Root with Checkbox.Indicator and a visible associated label, usually inside Field.

rules.statement: Provide a visible label for each checkbox unless the visual context is truly redundant and an accessible name remains.
Use checkbox semantics only for independently selectable values or a documented aggregate mixed state.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a checkbox for mutually exclusive choices.
commonMistakes.correction: Use RadioGroup for a one-of-many decision.

validation: Inspect checked or mixed state and submitted name/value.
